config.selection_policy: reuse original per-h selection.json; no tuning
config.training_policy: expanding prequential; target_date <= origin_date; no warmup exclusion
config.invalid_value_policy: abort entire experiment; no clipping, fallback or dropped pairs
config.rw_comparison: descriptive only; excluded from primary inference family
config.direction_zero_rule: exact delta == 0 for actual and prediction

no_2026_policy: Date-filter CSV rows before numeric parsing; whole-file hashes include 2026 for provenance only

validation.m1_repeat_scope: first/middle/last origin at each h; prediction and prediction_target float64 exact
